svg.title: Gorge Run: a three-way king of the hill map
svg.desc: Each base looks down its own gorge to the hill. Between the gorges stand highlands shared by two neighbours, each reached by a ramp from either base; from there, artillery covers both gorges. The hill is a cliff-edged butte with one ramp per gorge, and bots can climb to it from the highland tips.
svg.text: Three-way king of the hill · 18 × 18 map (9216 game units square) · 1v1v1 to 3v3v3
Each base looks down its own gorge to the hill. Between the gorges stand highlands shared by two
neighbours, each reached by a ramp from either base; from there, artillery covers both gorges. The
hill is a cliff-edged butte with one ramp per gorge, and bots can climb to it from the highland tips.
Heights: bases and gorges 200 · highlands 340 · the butte (the hill) 380
Planet Ochre · a red canyon desert world
Ground: red sandstone in bands on the highland walls, orange sand down the gorges, pale caliche on
Plants: a few ad0_senegal palms where the gorges meet below the butte (a dry oasis), nothing on the
Features: rocks30_desert boulders and scree under every cliff, sun-bleached unit heaps (armaak_heap
and its kind) in the gorges.
Sky and weather: deep blue sky, heat shimmer; wind 8 to 22; tidal 0.
Each third is the same, turned 120° about the hill. Heights in game units; lighter ground stands higher.
